description: This Java source file defines the ExampleAgent class, which extends BackupAgent, providing custom backup and restore logic for an Android application. It handles backup of simple boolean and integer data representing a application's state, including reading from and writing to data files, managing versioning of backup data, and restoring data from backup streams.

classes.name: ExampleAgent
classes.description: A BackupAgent subclass implementing custom backup and restore logic for application data, including version management and state persistence.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the backup agent, setting up the data file location.

methods.name: onBackup
methods.description: Handles the process of backing up application data, checking for changes, and writing data and state to the backup transport.

methods.name: compareStateFile
methods.description: Compares the existing state file with current data to decide if a backup is necessary.

methods.name: writeStateFile
methods.description: Writes the current application data state, including version, to the state file.

methods.name: onRestore
methods.description: Restores application data from the backup stream and updates the local data file accordingly.
